Erin, saw Stampli launched Procurement and is expanding into Austin with a wave of new sales hires.

More product and more reps usually means more follow-up volume than the SDR team can keep up with, and slow response time is where good leads slip away. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across email and LinkedIn, so your reps focus on live conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to speed up follow-up across the team.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to peer software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
